description: Frozen golden manifest for the cumulative Phase-5 catalog (guanlan_v2.orchestration.bootstrap.phase5_catalog_snapshot). base_catalog_digest MUST equal the immutable cumulative Phase-4 catalog digest (guanlan_v2.orchestration.trial.PHASE4_CATALOG_DIGEST), the sole legal base; catalog_digest seals the cumulative Phase-5 catalog. Phase 5 adds EXACTLY FOUR final workers (the three Lane 0 finals market.factor/market.regime/market.rotation plus the #25 market.factor_miner offline placeholder, ruling R9) and the Lane 0 experience capability/bridge + #25 prompt/skill materials. Every inherited Phase-4 manifest entry and worker (incl. compat.*) passes through byte-identical. The #25 placeholder is catalog-slot-only: no trusted handler is registered, no preset graph or DAG references it (the frozen WorkerSpec schema forces final workers to selection_scope='dynamic_allowed'; the never-selected intent is carried by the absent handler + absent graph reference + offline material text). NEVER auto-regenerated by tests. See tests/orchestration/test_phase5_registry.py.
